summary: Intelligent Onboarding Feature Testing Complete - 100% Backend (16/16 tests), 100% Frontend. Fixed critical bug in health_engine.py that caused 500 errors when creating profiles with minimal data. All 6 onboarding wizard steps work correctly, profile submission and assessment results display properly.

fixed_issues.issue: TypeError: '<=' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'int' - The calculate_risk_scores() and generate_health_assessment() functions failed when optional profile fields (sleep_quality, stress_level, age) were None instead of having default values
fixed_issues.fix: Added explicit None checks before comparisons: 'if sleep_quality is None: sleep_quality = 7' for all numeric comparisons

critical_code_review_comments: Backend health profile API properly handles all data types and returns correct assessment
Deficiency risk scoring works correctly - vegan diet triggers B12, iron, omega3 risks
All 6 onboarding steps have proper form fields, chips, sliders
Progress bar and step dots update correctly
Assessment results show BMI, deficiencies with risk levels (Hoch/Mittel), food sources
Language switcher (DE/IT) functional on home and disclaimer screens
seed_data_creation: Multiple health profiles created during testing with various configurations (vegan diet, stress levels, conditions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ONBOARDING FEATURE FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Health profile APIs: GET /api/onboarding/options?lang=de|it, POST /api/health-profile (creates profile + returns assessment), GET /api/health-profile/{id} (retrieves profile + assessment), PUT /api/health-profile/{id} (updates + regenerates assessment). Assessment includes BMI calculation, nutrient deficiency risks based on diet/lifestyle/conditions/medications, priority action areas. Frontend uses AsyncStorage to store health_profile_id after submission. Bug fixed in health_engine.py for handling None values in optional fields.
